(async()=>{const root=document.querySelector('#motion-0');const p=root.dataset.progress;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));if(root.dataset.progress!==p)throw Error('reduced moving');if(root.querySelector('[data-motion-play]').textContent!=='Next frame')throw Error('reduced label');root.querySelector('[data-motion-play]').click();if(Number(root.dataset.progress)<=Number(p))throw Error('next frame');if(!root.classList.contains('motion-flat'))throw Error('mobile default should be flat');return 'reduced-motion static/next-frame and mobile flat passed';})()
